copy.title: Core Builds Glyphs Pack
copy.short_description: 1023 square glyph icons for Android TV launchers. No ads, no account.
copy.full_description:
The square half of Core Builds Icon Pack: 1023 icons drawn as flat, single-colour glyphs, for launchers that show square tiles.

SAME APPS, SQUARE ART
Core Builds Icon Pack draws 16:9 banners. This pack draws the same apps as square glyphs, mapped to the same 1958 launcher components, so switching between the two changes what an icon looks like, never which apps get one.

HOW TO USE IT
Choose Core Builds Glyphs Pack in your launcher's icon pack list (on Projectivy: Settings, then Icon pack), or flip Art style inside Core Builds Icon Pack, which brings you here if this pack is missing.

WHAT IT IS
A resource pack with one screen, which shows how many icons it carries and opens the icon pack. Applying the pack works on its own. Picking a single icon by hand goes through Core Builds Icon Pack's picker, so that needs the icon pack installed, and the catalogue, the wallpapers and the settings live there too.

PRIVACY
No internet permission, no ads, no analytics, no account. This pack sends nothing at all.

tv_screenshots.depicts: the pack's one screen: its counts and the way to the icon pack

data_safety.rationale: The app declares no permissions, INTERNET included, and links no SDK: it is icon art, an appfilter and one screen. Nothing leaves the device.

content_rating.note: A square icon pack. Nothing here is user-generated, shared or interactive with strangers, it sells nothing (Core Builds Plus is the icon pack's, not this app's), and with no INTERNET permission everything it shows is in the install.
